subject: Operational evidence & custody questions during throughput spike - Nimbus Analytics
messages:
From: Ari Kaplan <ari@nimbanalytics.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: rohan.singh@nimbanalytics.com
Date: 2026-10-15T09:12:04-07:00
Subject: High 95th latency + errors between 10:02-10:18 PDT — evidence and retention questions

Hi Stephanie,

We saw a severe throughput spike and elevated 5xx errors against our integration between 10:02–10:18 PDT this morning. Our product ops team needs to understand what data you can provide for our internal postmortem and any compliance audit. Specifically: 

- Can you export request/response logs (including request ids, timestamps, and error codes) for that time window?
- Are the logs preserved in raw form (with original headers) or are they truncated/obfuscated in storage?
- Do logs include user identifiers or customer-generated payloads that we should consider PII and handle accordingly?
- If you place an internal legal hold / preservation flag, what is the chain-of-custody and who signs off?

We will likely be asked to produce an evidence packet for our security/compliance team and possibly legal, so any guidance on redaction recommendations or accepted export formats (CSV, JSON, syslog) is appreciated.

Thanks — this is urgent for our RCA.

— Ari
Senior SRE, Nimbus Analytics

Attachment: (screenshot) error-rate-1015.png
From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Ari Kaplan <ari@nimbanalytics.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-15T09:28:51-07:00
Subject: Re: High 95th latency + errors between 10:02-10:18 PDT — evidence and retention questions

Thanks Ari — sorry for the disruption. We're already collecting evidence from the runtime and infra layers. Quick notes: 

- We're preparing a time-bounded export (10:00–10:20 PDT) that will include request IDs, model shard routing, error codes, and latency percentiles.
- Raw request/response payloads are stored in a short-retention hot store for 30 days by default; we can produce a secure snapshot and perform an access-controlled long-term preservation if you need it.
- PII handling: by default we mask obvious tokens and API keys; payloads are not automatically redacted beyond configured mask rules. We'll flag any fields that look like user identifiers for your review.

I'll assign Monica (CS ops) to coordinate the export and David (Security/Forensics) to confirm preservation steps and sign the chain-of-custody. Expect an initial package within 4 hours.

-Stephanie
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference

[Redwood internal note: Incident tracked OPS-7862]
From: monica_patel@redwood.com <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Ari Kaplan <ari@nimbanalytics.com>, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: david_kim@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-15T11:03:22-07:00
Subject: Re: High 95th latency + errors between 10:02-10:18 PDT — evidence and retention questions

Hi Ari — Monica here. We're assembling the export now. Planned deliverables:

1) incident_snapshot.json — metadata for each request (request_id, ts, route, model_variant, latency_ms, status_code, instance_id).
2) syslog_excerpt.txt — agent-level logs and kubelet events around the windows that show GPU preemption/oom events where applicable.
3) s3_preservation_manifest.csv — manifest of objects preserved to our secure bucket (WORM), with SHA256 checksums and retention tags.

Operational constraints / asks for you:
- Please confirm which fields you consider sensitive so we can redact at export time (email addresses, account_id, customer_user_id). If we don't hear back in 2 hours we'll redact account_id and customer_user_id by default.
- Provide an email address for encrypted delivery and whether Nimbus prefers an SFTP drop or a secure Drive link.

Attachments (preliminary): syslog_excerpt.txt (partial), incident_snapshot.json (schema-only). Final package will include the full files and a preservation manifest.

Monica Patel
Customer Success Operations, Redwood Inference

---
Attachment stubs: syslog_excerpt.txt (10 KB excerpt), incident_snapshot_schema.json (1 KB)
From: david_kim@redwood.com <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: Ari Kaplan <ari@nimbanalytics.com>, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-15T13:45:09-07:00
Subject: Re: High 95th latency + errors between 10:02-10:18 PDT — evidence and retention questions

A few security/forensics points (incoming):

- Preservation: we'll create a time-stamped WORM copy in the preservation bucket and attach a manifest with SHA256 sums. That manifest will be included in s3_preservation_manifest.csv.
- Chain-of-custody: I'll sign the internal legal_hold_notice.pdf and record the custodians (Monica, David) and the redwood-ops S3 path.
- Access: exports will be encrypted with a customer-provided PGP key or we can use our internal KMS envelope and a short-term encrypted link. Please advise preference.
- Integrity: do not mutate original raw logs. All redaction for PII will be applied to copies and we will preserve originals.

Monica — once you have the files, I'll timestamp and push the preservation manifest and legal hold stamp. Marcus — please confirm whether there were any cross-region fallbacks during the window.

David Kim
Head of Security & Forensics, Redwood Inference

Attachment: legal_hold_notice.pdf (signed-draft)
From: Rohan Singh <rohan.singh@nimbanalytics.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: Ari Kaplan <ari@nimbanalytics.com>, david_kim@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-16T14:07:11-07:00
Subject: Re: High 95th latency + errors between 10:02-10:18 PDT — evidence and retention questions

Thanks Monica / David / Stephanie — appreciate the quick coordination. A few clarifications before you finalize export: 

- Delivery: we prefer encrypted S3 presigned URLs (expiration 7 days) delivered to ops-evidence@nimbanalytics.com and would like a separate low-privilege copy for our auditors.
- Redaction: please redact customer_user_id and email addresses in the auditor copy but keep raw originals in the WORM bucket for legal review.
- Timeline: can you confirm ETA for the full package and the signed legal_hold_notice? Our compliance team expects receipt within 24 hours to meet an internal deadline.

If you can confirm the delivery method and ETA we will mark this as high priority on our side.

Best,
Rohan Singh
Head of Product Ops, Nimbus Analytics

Received attachments referenced in thread: incident_snapshot.json (attached), syslog_excerpt.txt (attached)
